Name: Recipe Tracker
Author: noxkimaera
Description:
This mod provides UI to track crafting recipes, blueprint, bundles and quests

[size=5]Default Controls[/size]

- Press Z while in game (not a menu) to hide or show tracking UI
- Shift+Z to clear tracking list
- Hover on a recipe in crafting menu, or select any bundle/blueprint/quest, and press Z to pin it

[size=5]Config[/size]

Tracking UI position and keybindings can be customized via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
